gist: Archival file cover: Фонд Дирекція имп. театров; Дело «О „Ежегодникѣ имп. театров“»; begun 17 Jan 1893, ended 17 Nov 1904; ЦГИАЛ stamps ф. 497 оп. 18 ед. хр. 1167 (old no. 2967?).
why: Cover; gives date span of the file only.

from_to: К. А. Петровъ (Заведывающій Центральною библіотекою Имп. театровъ) -> Милостивый Государь (Moscow correspondent, prob. К. Здобновъ?)
gist: Printed letterhead of the Central Library. Petrov acknowledges money 72 р. 90 к. sent in envelope № 1256 in the name of А. Е. Молчановъ, transferred via the Контора Юнкеръ (bank office). Continues p.3. (Pencil folio 26 top right.)
why: Remittance of Yearbook sale money from Moscow to the editor's name; first issue accounts.

gist: Continuation: the money was received and handed over 'по принадлежности'; Анатолій Евграфовичъ [Молчановъ] was unable(?) to notify you himself. Petrov asks: 1) how many copies of the «Ежегодникъ» were with you; 2) how many remain now, after remitting the 72 roubles.
why: Petrov querying Moscow stock of the Yearbook (issue 1) for the accounts.

gist: Continuation: 3) are copies of Левенсонъ (the Moscow printer/subscription agent) included in the number sold through you, or is there to be a separate account with him? This information is needed 'для составленія отчета о „Ежегодникѣ“'; reply to be sent to the Контора театровъ in(?) the Central Library.
why: Request for figures for the official report on the Yearbook; Левенсон's separate copies.

gist: End of Petrov's letter: 'Готовый къ услугамъ К. Петровъ'; pencil at left 'конц.(?) Сергѣевъ(?)'. Below begins a reply written on the same sheet in another hand ('Въ отвѣтъ на это письмо ...'), continued on p.6 (overlapping view).
why: Signature of the request and start of the reply; overlaps p.6.

from_to: Moscow correspondent (К. Здобновъ?) -> К. А. Петровъ
gist: Overlapping view of p.5's lower part, with full text of the reply: in late January(?) a copy of the account of receipts and expenditure of money for the «Ежегодникъ» 1890/91 was sent to К. А. Петровъ ... sent 2 Dec(?) 1892 ...; signed with a flourish 'К. Здобновъ?' (same signature as p.9). Several words uncertain.
why: Reply concerning the income/expenditure account of the 1890/91 Yearbook.

gist: Docket at top: 'Отвѣтъ на увѣдомленіе о полученіи денегъ и на просьбу сообщить о числѣ оставшихся экз. Ежегодника'. Received 25 Jan 1893. Thanks for notice that А. Е. Молчановъ received the 72 р. 90 к.; encloses a detailed account (расчетъ) of the «Ежегодникъ» received by him, and concerning the Губернская типографія ... (continued p.8).
why: Moscow office's answer with an account of Yearbook copies and money.

gist: Continuation: concerning the Губернская типографія — he sent there 20 copies and received from them, including those received earlier and paid for, 6 copies(?). Detailed information on the Губернская типографія and its accounts were communicated by the Контора театровъ in its отношеніе of 11 Nov 1892 № 2102 to the SPb Контора театровъ, so he does not repeat them.
why: Copies placed for sale with the (Moscow) Губернская типографія; cross-reference to Контора correspondence.

gist: Overlapping view of p.8 with the closing: dated 22 Jan 1893, 'Готовый къ услугамъ Вашимъ К. Здобновъ(?)'.
why: Overlapping view; adds date and signature of the Moscow correspondent.

from_to: К. А. Петровъ (Заведывающій Центральною библіотекою) -> Константинъ Романовичъ [Здобновъ?]
gist: Central Library letterhead (folio 30 in pencil). Petrov telegraphed today about delivering information on the number of subscribers at Левенсонъ for the new «Ежегодникъ»; he has been instructed to ask you to arrange quickly obtaining from Левенсонъ ... (continued p.11).
why: Subscriptions for the new (2nd) issue taken through Левенсонъ in Moscow.

gist: Continuation: ... obtaining from Левенсонъ all receipt books (квитанціонныя книжки) and the money he has received for subscriptions. The addresses of Левенсон's subscribers he should keep for sending the copies of the «Ежегодникъ»; the books either to be delivered to us or left with you ...
why: Recovery of subscription receipt books and money from the Moscow agent.

gist: Continuation: ... or kept with you in the Контора. On Saturday the «Ежегодникъ» is to be presented to the Sovereign ('подносится Государю') and probably on Monday the first transport will be sent to you. Two further requests: first, tell your brother that «Кн. Дадновъ?» [unclear title] is being sent today; second, concerning the 1st выпускъ of the Ежегодникъ (continued p.13). Right edge shows the start of p.14's column.
why: Presentation of the new Yearbook to the Emperor and first shipment to Moscow, March 1893.

gist: Overlapping view, continuation: Левенсонъ must send a detailed report on sales of the 1st выпускъ: 1) how many copies received in all; 2) how many issued to subscribers; 3) how many sold and (if possible) how many in which months; 4) if any were issued free ... (continued p.14). Margin of next column: '4 Марта 1893'.
why: Questions specifying the sales report required from Левенсон for issue 1.

gist: Folio 4 (pencil 31). ... free copies: when and to whom; 5) how much money handed over for sales and when; 6) how many of the 1st issue were issued to subscribers for both issues at once; 7) how many copies are left. 'Простите за безпокойство, поклонъ Москвѣ. Готовый къ услугамъ К. Петровъ'. Pencil at top 'въ Мск(?)'.
why: Completes the questionnaire on issue-1 sales, free copies and remaining stock; signed by Petrov.

gist: Overlapping view: Petrov's signature, then a postscript: for the Moscow ...(?) [copies?] ... persons, and then they will be immediately sent to you (partly unread). Docket/marginal note: '4 Марта 1893 г. Отношеніе Московской Конторы отъ 11 Ноябр. 1892 г. № 2112'.
why: Postscript and filing note; overlaps p.14.

from_to: Редакція журнала «Всемірная Иллюстрація», кабинетъ редактора -> Анатолій Евграфовичъ [Молчановъ]
gist: Letterhead of the editorial office of «Всемірная Иллюстрація» (Большая Садовая 16). Resolution 'Выдать' with flourish at top. The редакція of «Всем. Иллюстр.» has not received the «Ежегодникъ» ... ; asks for a copy in the name of П. А. Быковъ, Коломенская ул. 1/15, кв. 17; 'мы дадимъ обстоятельный отзывъ(?)'. Signature on p.17.
why: Press request for a review copy for an illustrated weekly, approved 'Выдать': reception/press distribution.

gist: Overlapping view of p.16's lower half with the signature: 'Пред. Ва[мъ]' and an illegible signature (Г. Сте...?).
why: Overlapping view; adds the (unread) signature of the «Всемірная Иллюстрація» correspondent.

gist: Verso with stray notes: 'Укрощ. строптивой 86-87'; 'Ленскаго 82-83 ноябр.'; 'Цурева? 82'; upside-down at foot an address-like note (unread). Apparently jottings about past drama performances (Ленскій), not about the Yearbook's business.
why: Stray jottings; unclear purpose; no ballet.

from_to: Русское Театральное Общество, Театральное справочно-статистическое бюро (Москва) -> А. Е. Молчановъ, г. редакторъ «Ежегодника Императорскихъ Театровъ»
gist: Letterhead of the Russian Theatrical Society's Театральное справочно-статистическое бюро, Moscow. Resolution 'Выдать' at top. The Bureau is organising a reading room and library, for which publications on the history and present state of theatre and music are especially important; among them the «Ежегодникъ» edited by Molchanov ... (continued p.20).
why: Addressed to Molchanov explicitly as редакторъ of the Yearbook (1896); library request approved.

gist: Overlapping view of p.19 showing the inside address 'Его Высокородію А. Е. Молчанову, г. редактору «Ежегодника Императорскихъ Театровъ»' and the praise: the Yearbook, by its irreproachable fulfilment of its tasks, is 'совершенно исключительное явленіе' and thus especially necessary for the Bureau's library.
why: Names Molchanov as editor; contemporary assessment of the Yearbook (reception).

gist: Close of the Bureau's letter: asks Molchanov to petition the Direction of the Imperial Theatres to send the Bureau the Yearbook for the current season and all previous ones from the very start of its publication. Signed 'Управляющій Бюро А. Ярцевъ'.
why: Request for a complete run of the Yearbook for the RTO bureau library; signatory А. Ярцевъ.

gist: Blank verso of the Bureau letter, folio 7 only; edge of the facing page visible.
why: Blank.

gist: Received by the Central Library 17 Jan 1893. Docket top right: '18 Янв. отвѣч.(?) съ запросомъ о числѣ оставшихся экземпляровъ. К. П.' Text: on 14 December last year I sent you in envelope № 1256, in your name, a transfer of the Контора Юнкера for 72 р. 90 к. for ... (continued next page). This is the letter Petrov's p.2 answers.
why: Remittance of Yearbook sale money to the editor, Dec 1892; starts the Jan 1893 exchange.

doc_type: letter (lower part, start on previous page)
from_to: bookseller? -> Yearbook office (addressee not named on this view)
gist: Writer reminds the addressee that he sent, via a transfer from the Контора Юнкера, 72 руб. 90 к. for copies of the «Ежегодникъ» for the 1890-1891 season that he had sold, and had asked for an acknowledgement of receipt; none has come, so he asks again.
why: Sales remittance (72 р. 90 к. for copies of 1890-91 sold); routine distribution, no print-run figures.

gist: Overlapping view of p. 24 with the close of the letter: repeats the request for acknowledgement of the 72 р. 90 к. remitted for sold copies of the 1890-91 Ежегодникъ; signed «Вашъ покорнѣйшій слуга К. Здобновъ?» (surname doubtful), dated 16 January 1893.
why: Completes p. 24 (signature and date); routine sales remittance.

gist: Manuscript text on М. Н. Ермолова: on 19 January 1896 she celebrated the 25th anniversary of her artistic career, with an appreciation of her as foremost representative of the Russian dramatic stage. Printer's/compositor's marks (Т, F) in the margin suggest copy for the Yearbook (1895-96 issue?).
why: Copy for a Yearbook item on Ермолова's jubilee (drama); editorial marks only implied, author not shown.

gist: Second photo of the lower part of f. 9 (p. 26): end of the Ермолова jubilee paragraph and the paragraph marked F praising her as representative of the first dramatic stage of Russia.
why: Duplicate view of p. 26.

gist: «Многоуважаемый Людвигъ Александровичъ»: the writer sends for the «Ежегодникъ» three more photographs (карточки) of honoured artists, beginning with Марія Николаевна Ермолова. Addressee is Л. А. Гельмерсенъ (named on p. 33 of a related letter).
why: Photographs sent to the Yearbook office for illustration (1904); Гельмерсенъ as the recipient of contributions.

gist: Lists the three photographs: 1) М. Н. Ермолова (rather poor; better to reproduce only the head), 2) Гликерія Николаевна Федотова (very good photo), 3) Николай Игнатьевичъ Музиль (also good, though not recent).
why: Illustration content and quality judgements for the Yearbook's portraits.

gist: Asks that the Федотова and Музиль photographs be returned, as they were borrowed from the artists themselves and no other copies exist. Begins: as for the little article «Щепкинъ», ...
why: Loan/return of illustration photographs; an article «Щепкинъ» offered to the Yearbook.

gist: Ends the letter: on the article «Щепкинъ» — whether the addressee will take it whole or only an extract (reading partly doubtful), and photographs and decorations (декораціи) to be taken/shot. Signed with an illegible flourish; dated 5 January 1904.
why: Contributor correspondence about an article and photographs/sets for the 1904 Yearbook; signature unread.

gist: «Милостивый Государь Людвигъ Александровичъ»: the writer asks for the return of the copies of documents on the theatre that he sent for consideration last year, since he has received an offer to publish the theatre materials on more favourable terms.
why: A contributor withdraws materials submitted to the Yearbook for another publisher; Гельмерсенъ handling submissions in 1903-04.

from_to: С. Б[...]левичъ? -> Его Высокородію Л. А. Гельмерсену
gist: Close of the 7 April 1904 letter: «...на болѣе выгодныхъ условіяхъ». Signed «С. Б[...]левичъ?» (surname doubtful); addressed at foot «Его Высокородію Л. А. Гельмерсену».
why: Names the addressee: Л. А. Гельмерсенъ receiving contributor correspondence for the Yearbook in 1904.

gist: «Милостивый Государь Людвигъ Александровичъ!» The writer says that in April 1902 he sent, addressed to the Director of Theatres, an article on Гоголь ...
why: Contributor's article on Гоголь submitted for the Yearbook.

from_to: И. И. Ивановъ -> Л. А. Гельмерсенъ
gist: ... which was to be printed in the «Ежегодникъ». He now needs it for his lectures and asks that it be sent to him for a few days.
why: Article accepted for but not printed in the Yearbook; author asks for manuscript back.

from_to: И. И. Ивановъ -> Л. А. Гельмерсенъ
gist: Promises to return the article immediately; adds that his article on Мочаловъ (a speech given at the Moscow Малый театръ for the Мочаловъ anniversary) likewise never appeared in the Ежегодникъ.
why: Second commissioned/submitted article (Мочаловъ) left unprinted: evidence of contents decisions.

from_to: И. И. Ивановъ -> Л. А. Гельмерсенъ
gist: Again asks for the Гоголь article to be sent. Signed «И. Ивановъ», Членъ Московскаго отдѣленія Театрально-Литературнаго Комитета; address: Москва, Воздвиженка?, гост. Петергофъ (И. И. Иванову).
why: Identifies the contributor (И. И. Ивановъ) of unprinted Гоголь and Мочаловъ articles.

from_to: И. И. Ивановъ -> Л. А. Гельмерсенъ
gist: Postscript: the Moscow address holds until about 20 May? (reading doubtful); if no answer by then, summer address is гор. Бѣлый, Смоленской губ. Dated 29 April [1]904.
why: Date and summer address for the Ивановъ letter; little content of its own.

from_to: Товарищество Р. Голике и А. Вильборгъ (signature unread) -> Ваше Превосходительство (addressee not named)
gist: Letterhead of Товарищество Р. Голике и А. Вильборгъ (Типографія, Литографія, Фототипія, Цинкографія, Звенигородская 11). The writer apologises that the proof sheets (листы въ корректуру) could not be delivered as usual because of a mishap: a compositor spilled about a hundred lines of type.
key_names: Товарищество Р. Голике и А. Вильборгъ
why: Printing-house dealing with proofs, November 1904.

gist: Continuation: the type will be reset and proofs supplied within a week (or in two days: «вчера и сегодня» in brackets; reading partial). Signed with an unread signature beginning Ш?/Щ?.
why: Printer's proof delay; production of the Yearbook in late 1904.

gist: «Отчетъ по изданію [3го выпуска struck] Ежегодника Императорскихъ театровъ (сезона 1892-93 г.)»: printed in 4000 copies (3900 on plain paper for sale, 100 honorary on слоновая [веленевая struck] paper); each copy has 37 printed sheets (588 pages) and 345 drawings. Стоимость изданія: 1) paper — plain 160 ст. 16 д. at 9 р. 45 к. = 1519 р. 56 к.; веленевая 23 ст. 14 д. at 12 р. 72 к. = 301 р. 41 к.; Bristol card 59 р. 25 к.; coloured cover paper 3 ст. at 11 р. = 33 р.
why: Print run, page count, illustration count and paper costs of the 1892-93 Yearbook.

gist: Cost items: paper total 1913 р. 22 к.; 2) Печатаніе: setting and printing (with subscription announcements) 1483 р. 60 к., brochure binding 30 р., bindings (3 at 20 р., 20 at 3 р. 50 к.) 130 р., lithography 45 р.; 3) Рисунки: artist's fee 19?3 р. 60 к. (digit blotted), engravings 470 р., clichés 276 р. (subtotal 90 fl. 85 kr. and 2645 р. 86 к.); 4) Литературная и редакціонная часть: fees to authors 495 р., Вознагражденіе редактору 2400 р. (2895 р.); 5) petty expenses 120 р.; total 10917? р. 68 к. (corrected).
why: Full budget incl. author fees (495 р.) and the editor's fee (2400 р.) for 1892-93.

gist: Overlapping view of the cost table plus: counting 90 fl. 85 kr. as about 70 рублей, total expenditure comes to 1028? р. [corrected to 1024?/1033?, digits doubtful] ... after deducting 300 р. (struck phrase about exceeding the approved estimate).
why: Total cost reconciliation for 1892-93 (figures partly corrected/doubtful).

gist: Crossed-out draft explaining the overspend: the Yearbook was enlarged by 7 printed sheets over the estimate, costing 784 р. (56 ст. paper 529 р. 20 к., printing 255 р. 50 к.); the sum assigned for this issue (9269 р.) was exceeded by 1060 р., explained by one-off purchase of typographic ornaments (типографскія украшенія) usable for later issues.
why: Estimate (9269 р.) vs actual cost and reasons; budget policy.

gist: Revised text: exceeding the estimated 9269 р. [above: 10382] by 1113 р. [corrected from 1060] is explained 1) by enlarging the Ежегодникъ by 7 printed sheets, needing over 700 р. more for paper and the printer, and 2) a one-off outlay (sum left blank) for various typographic ornaments, needed not only for the 3rd issue but for all later ones. Foot: «За объявленія 567 р.»
why: Final explanation of overspend; issue numbered 3rd (1892-93); advertisement income 567 р.

gist: Same text as p. 45 from «типографскихъ украшеній ... съ другой стороны увеличеніемъ объема» onward, with the corrected figures (9269 р., 10382, 1113 р.), «во 1хъ/во 2хъ» points, and «За объявленія 567 р.»; marginal pencil scribble at right edge.
why: Overlapping view of p. 45; content already recorded there.
